verifiedEvidence: I compared the candidate with the official question row (crop q47.png). The question text matches exactly: 「⑰で示す部分に使用するトラフは。」 It has no negation, number or unit.

Page 15 of the official common wiring diagram, 1st-floor plan: ⑰ points to the vertical dash-dot underground line in the parking area (駐車場) on the right. That line runs between two handholes (◎), and a 「トラフ」 leader label and trough mark sit at the tip of the ⑰ arrow. The candidate's description, an underground section through the parking lot marked トラフ, matches this.

Official photos, checked against the public image q47-1.png (same content and order as the official crop): イ is a pale orange strip with red text 「危険　注意／この下に低圧電力ケーブルあり」. ロ is a grey U-section channel with a lid laid over part of it. ハ is a black pipe with a corrugated (ridged) outer surface. ニ is a black-sheathed cable end with two insulated cores exposed. All four choice descriptions match the photos.
Official answer ロ is kept unchanged. The candidate says ロ is the only choice with a body plus lid, and the photo confirms this.

The explanations for イ, ハ and ニ rest only on facts visible in the photos: the wording printed on the sheet, the corrugated outer shape and the cable end. There is no separate legal or standards claim, so officialReferenceUrls can stay empty. The explanation, per-choice reasons and diagramDescription do not contradict each other.
I compared the candidate with the official question row (crop q50.png). The question text matches exactly: 「⑳で示す図記号の電線管をモーターに接続するために使用されるものは。」

Page 15 of the official common wiring diagram, 1st-floor factory (1階工場), upper left: ⑳ points to the segment annotated 「(F2 30)」, between the 3.7kW motor M (with its earth symbol) and the dashed box marked ⑩ (connected to the d circuit). The candidate's diagramDescription matches this.

Official photos, checked against the public image q50-1.png (same content and order as the official crop): イ is a metal cylinder with set screws and a screwed-on metal strip on the side, a smooth inner surface and a thread/locknut at the rear. ロ is a metal cylinder with a spiral groove on the inside and a thread/nut at the rear. ハ is a black plastic fitting with stepped, wavy ridges on the rear outer surface and a ring at the front. ニ is a grey rigid plastic fitting with vertical slit claws around the inner rim. All four choice descriptions and per-choice reasons match the photos.
Official answer ロ is kept unchanged.

Primary source: the candidate's officialReferenceUrl is https://www.mlit.go.jp/gobuild/content/001879783.pdf. WebFetch returned the PDF, but its compressed streams could not be decoded into text. I therefore checked against the fixed official primary-source pack for Q50 (pack SHA256 a122e7ce…ce96; PDF SHA256 511427a0…2524): MLIT Government Building Repair Division (官庁営繕部), 『公共建築設備工事標準図（電気設備工事編）令和4年版』, PDF page 23 / printed page 22, conduit table (管類). There, F2 corresponds to 「金属製可とう電線管」, and on the same row 「F2WP ビニル被覆金属製可とう電線管」 is shown as the vinyl-covered F2. This supports the explanation's statement that F2 means flexible metal conduit (金属製可とう電線管).
